Package org.osgi.test.cases.remoteservices.junit

Interface DistributionProviderConstants

public interface DistributionProviderConstants
The constants described here are set on a service that identifies the Distribution Provider. Every Distribution Provider registers exactly one service in the local Service Registry with these properties. The service provides information about the Distribution Provider through properties set on the service registration.

A Distribution Provider does not have to use this service interface but must register some service with the REMOTE_INTENTS_SUPPORTED and REMOTE_CONFIGS_SUPPORTED service properties to denote the intents and configuration types supported by the distribution provider.

  • Field Details

    • REMOTE_CONFIGS_SUPPORTED

      static final String REMOTE_CONFIGS_SUPPORTED
      The Configuration Types supported by this Distribution Provider.

      Services that are suitable for remoting list the configuration types that describe the distribution metadata for that service in the

      invalid reference 
      RemoteServiceConstants.SERVICE_EXPORTED_CONFIGS
      property. Not every Distribution Provider will support all configuration types. The value of this property on the Distribution Provider service list the configuration types supported by this one.

      The value of this property is of type String, String[] or Collection of String.
